verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI evidence is an AI writing and editing aid. That helps write content; it does not generate insights or suggestions from the user's board data. The MCP server connects Trello to external AI tools, so it is not an in-product insights capability and gets no credit. No evidence shows AI analysis, summaries, or recommendations drawn from the user's own data inside Trello.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
